name: ANS Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, ANS Industries Limited is a food processing company. The company is into the manufacturing and marketing of frozen foods and vegetables.
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio:[1]
The company offers fruits and vegetables such as, tomato puree, water chestnut, carrots, okras, beans, sweet and baby corns, peas, papayas, potatoes, red cherries, mushrooms, spinach, mangoes, green choliya, and cauliflowers in frozen forms.

cons: Stock is trading at 3.62 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -29.0% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
